E.25_convention_paragraph:
The convention $\rho_N=-c_N$ is the one proved in D.5.
No identification of this coefficient on the whole GT source
with a different matrix-defined extension of a Galois Kummer
character is needed for this finite calculation.
modular_memo_coefficient: D.5's coefficient is literal: c_N is the y-coordinate of delta_N(f), and rho_N=−c_N. Its full-GT distribution identity is the opened Enriquez theorem. The comparison with the stated arithmetic Kummer character is made on the Galois image.
modular_memo_earlier_scan: The independent scan found no earlier claim in D.5 or E.6 that needed this additional equality. D.5 states its exact coefficient convention and Galois comparison; E.6 uses only the induced maps (q delta_N,c_N). The preliminary proposed numerical exclusion from identifying extensions was withdrawn and is absent from the theorem files.
report_E.25_sentence: The coefficient convention is exactly rho_N=-c_N; agreement with a matrix-defined extension of a Kummer character on the whole GT group has not been established and is not used to exclude any point.
